title: Share links, embed tokens and public embed grants bind to the content that was shared — content written by anyone other than the minter is refused (409), minter writes re-arm the binding

criteria.then: reproduce the #2536 scenario for dashboards, notebooks and embed tokens: content changed after the link was minted is refused (409 CONTENT_CHANGED), unchanged content still serves

criteria.given: every share token, embed token and public embed grant record
criteria.then: carries a mint-time SHA-256 content binding plus a poison flag, and the guest read path (ShareViewResource, NotebookShareViewResource, EmbedViewResource) refuses with 409 when the served content no longer matches or a non-minter has written it

criteria.given: a repository file save that flows through DatasourceService.saveFile
criteria.then: a listener re-binds the stored content hash when the writer is the minter (links to objects only the minter writes keep working) and marks the record changed-by-other when anyone else wrote it
describes the chosen rule: links bind the minted content; non-minter edits invalidate; minter edits re-arm; pre-binding tokens bind on first use
